farmer_explanation: A modern, highly effective insecticide used to control destructive caterpillars and borers such as stem borer in paddy, shoot borer in sugarcane, and fruit borer in tomato and chilli.
why_farmers_use_it: Stops caterpillars and borers from feeding within minutes of ingestion, providing long-lasting crop protection with high safety to beneficial insects like honeybees and spiders.
safety_precautions: Wear rubber gloves and face mask while handling the concentrate.
Do not spray against the wind direction.
Keep away from poultry, livestock, and direct water sources.
Store in original container in a cool, dry place away from food items.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A trusted systemic protective and curative fungicide used to treat serious fungal diseases like sheath blight in paddy, powdery mildew in mango and grapes, and tikka leaf spot in groundnut.
why_farmers_use_it: Absorbed rapidly into plant tissues to stop existing fungal infections from spreading and protect newly developing leaves.
safety_precautions: Avoid contact with skin, eyes, and clothing.
Wash thoroughly with soap and water after spraying.
Do not contaminate ponds, canals, or water bodies.
Dispose of empty bottles safely by puncturing and burying.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A classic, broad-spectrum protective contact fungicide used across vegetables, cereals, and fruit crops to prevent leaf spots, blights, and rot.
why_farmers_use_it: Provides a protective shield on the leaf surface before fungal spores can penetrate. Widely used as a preventive spray before monsoon or rainy spells.
safety_precautions: Wear protective goggles and dust mask when measuring powder.
Harmful if inhaled or swallowed.
Toxic to fish and aquatic life; do not wash equipment in ponds.
Keep out of reach of children and animals.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: Specialist systemic blast fungicide used in paddy to prevent and cure devastating leaf blast and panicle neck blast.
why_farmers_use_it: Inhibits melanin formation in blast fungus, preventing it from piercing the rice leaf or breaking the grain neck during panicle emergence.
safety_precautions: Observe 30-day pre-harvest interval (PHI).
Wear full protective gear during application.
Poisonous to fish and aquatic life.
Avoid spraying during high winds or extreme heat.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A time-tested broad-spectrum contact fungicide and bactericide used extensively in plantation crops and vegetables to control rot, wilt, rust, and bacterial blight.
why_farmers_use_it: Releases copper ions that disrupt fungal and bacterial cell walls. Essential for pre-monsoon prophylactic protection in coffee, pepper, and arecanut.
safety_precautions: Do not apply in extremely hot sunny hours to prevent leaf scorching.
Corrosive to metal sprayers; rinse equipment thoroughly after use.
Wear protective gloves and apron.
Store in a dry location away from fertilizers.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A popular systemic insecticide used to control stubborn sap-sucking pests like aphids, thrips, whiteflies, and jassids on cotton, vegetables, and rice.
why_farmers_use_it: Translocates through the plant's vascular system to protect tender shoots and foliage against sucking insects that curl leaves and transmit viruses.
safety_precautions: Highly toxic to honeybees; avoid spraying during active foraging or flowering hours.
Do not breathe spray mist; wear respirator and gloves.
Do not contaminate honeybee hives or flowering weed patches.
Keep locked and out of reach of children.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A dual-action insecticide and mite killer (acaricide) specifically effective against whiteflies, thrips, and mites on cotton, chilli, and vegetables.
why_farmers_use_it: Activated by sunlight into a potent compound that paralyzes resistant sucking pests and spider mites underneath leaves.
safety_precautions: Spray during bright sunny hours for optimal photolytic activation.
Toxic to aquatic organisms; prevent runoff into water bodies.
Wear protective mask and clothing.
Store in a cool and well-ventilated storeroom.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A rapid-acting systemic neonicotinoid insecticide in easy-to-dissolve granules, used for soil drenching and foliar control of sucking insect pests.
why_farmers_use_it: Quickly taken up by plant roots and foliage, offering excellent rainfastness and systemic control of hidden hopper and aphid colonies.
safety_precautions: Highly toxic to pollinators; strictly avoid application during crop blooming period.
Do not drain leftover spray liquid near water channels.
Wear protective gear while mixing.
Store away from livestock feed.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A powerful bio-derived insecticide specialized in eliminating caterpillar borers, leaf miners, and fruit borers in cotton, vegetables, and pulses.
why_farmers_use_it: Penetrates leaf tissue (translaminar action) to create a reservoir that kills caterpillars as soon as they chew leaves, with minimal environmental residue.
safety_precautions: Wear protective rubber gloves and goggles while dissolving granules.
Harmful if swallowed or absorbed through skin.
Do not spray near fish ponds or open wells.
Observe recommended pre-harvest intervals.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A trusted combination fungicide providing dual contact and systemic protection against both internal and external fungal infections.
why_farmers_use_it: Combines systemic Carbendazim (travels inside the plant) with contact Mancozeb (surface shield), preventing fungal resistance while treating severe spots and blights.
safety_precautions: Wear protective mask when handling powder.
Avoid inhaling dust or mist.
Do not reuse container for any other purpose.
Wash hands and face with soap before eating.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A premium dual-action systemic fungicide offering preventive, curative, and eradicative protection against blights, blast, and anthracnose with crop greening benefits.
why_farmers_use_it: Enhances crop photosynthesis and leaf greenness ('greening effect') while simultaneously wiping out fungal spores and stopping disease spread.
safety_precautions: Do not apply more than 2 consecutive sprays to avoid fungal resistance.
Wear personal protective equipment (PPE).
Toxic to fish; avoid water contamination.
Keep away from children and domestic pets.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: Specialist anti-oomycete fungicide formulated specifically to conquer Late Blight in potato/tomato and Quick Wilt/Rot in plantation spices.
why_farmers_use_it: Enters plant tissue rapidly within 30 minutes, protecting delicate stems, roots, and developing tubers from destructive water-mold fungi.
safety_precautions: Always alternate with contact copper or mancozeb sprays to prevent resistance.
Wear rubber gloves and dust mask.
Do not contaminate streams or drinking water.
Store in a dry room below 35°C.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: High-technology rice hopper specialist that instantly stops feeding by Brown Plant Hoppers and Whitebacked Plant Hoppers.
why_farmers_use_it: Provides up to 21 days of continuous protection against hopper burn in paddy with minimal harm to natural enemy spiders.
safety_precautions: Direct spray nozzle toward the base of rice tillers where hoppers congregate.
Limit to a single application per season for resistance management.
Wear protective gear during handling.
Do not dispose into ponds or canals.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: An organic botanical bio-pesticide extracted from neem seed kernels, working as an anti-feedant, repellent, and insect growth regulator.
why_farmers_use_it: Safe for organic farming, zero chemical residues, safe to bees, and insects cannot develop resistance against multiple natural limonoids.
safety_precautions: Safe to handle with standard basic hygiene.
Spray during late afternoon hours to prevent degradation from intense ultraviolet sunlight.
Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sun.
dosage_guidance: Follow the product container label instructions and local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for recommended dilution.

farmer_explanation: A natural biocontrol fungus that colonizes plant root zones, parasitizes harmful soil fungi, and prevents root rot and wilt.
why_farmers_use_it: Safe, eco-friendly seed treatment and soil application that improves root development and stops soil-borne wilt without chemical residues.
safety_precautions: Do not mix with chemical fungicides or apply within 7 days of chemical fungicide application.
Mix with well-decomposed organic manure or FYM before field application.
Keep soil moist after application to help beneficial spores multiply.
dosage_guidance: Follow the package instructions and university recommendations for seed treatment or FYM enrichment.

farmer_explanation: STRICTLY BANNED CHEMICAL: Endosulfan is completely prohibited across the Republic of India by order of the Supreme Court of India.
why_farmers_use_it: DO NOT USE OR PURCHASE. Highly dangerous persistent chemical causing severe health hazards, congenital deformities, and environmental damage.
safety_precautions: DO NOT USE: Banned nationwide by the Supreme Court of India.
Possession, sale, or application is a criminal offense under the Insecticides Act 1968.
If found, do not apply. Contact local agricultural department for safe hazardous disposal.
dosage_guidance: NOT APPLICABLE — STRICTLY BANNED BY SUPREME COURT OF INDIA.

suitable_crops: Non-vegetable field crops only under strict supervision
farmer_explanation: HIGHLY RESTRICTED: Monocrotophos is strictly prohibited by law for use on all vegetables and fruit crops under Gazette Notification S.O. 3951(E).
why_farmers_use_it: PROHIBITED ON VEGETABLES: Extremely high acute mammalian toxicity causing nerve damage and severe chemical residue in harvested produce.
safety_precautions: DO NOT USE on tomatoes, chillies, brinjals, okra, cabbage, or any edible vegetables or fruits.
Severe organophosphate toxicity. Antidote: Atropine under medical supervision.
Violators are subject to legal penalty under the Insecticides Act 1968.
dosage_guidance: STRICTLY BANNED ON VEGETABLE AND FRUIT CROPS.
